verdict.rationale: Generating apps from designs is a fair axis for an AI coding agent, but nothing in the evidence pack covers image, sketch, or PDF input, or design-to-code generation. The documented file-reference insertion and multi-provider model support are adjacent features. They do not show that OpenCode turns a visual design into a working app.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design
